summary: Dedy Kredo, Co-Founder and CPO of CodiumAI, presents the company's approach to code quality and testing at the AI Engineer Summit 2023. He begins by drawing a parallel between Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Transformers. While GANs used two networks—one generating and one critiquing—Transformers dropped the adversarial component to focus solely on generation. Kredo argues that code is nuanced enough to warrant returning to a GAN-like system architecture, not at the neural network level but as a system concept: one component generates code, another serves as a code integrity critic that analyzes, reviews, and identifies edge cases to ensure code works as intended based on the developer's actual intent. CodiumAI focuses on this critic component, believing that behavior coverage is a more useful metric than traditional code coverage. Their tools help developers map code behaviors, generate tests for those behaviors, enhance code, and review code throughout the development lifecycle, available via IDE extensions for JetBrains and VS Code, a Git plugin, and upcoming APIs. The live demo uses an open-source project called Autoscraper, a 600-line scraping class with over 5,000 GitHub stars but no tests. Kredo shows CodiumAI mapping behaviors including happy path and edge cases, generating a test suite of nine tests, running them with an auto-fix mechanism that analyzes failures and attempts fixes through a chain-of-thought reflection process. He then demonstrates code enhancement suggestions such as replacing hash lib with Blake3 for performance, and shows PR preparation features including automated commit messages, PR reviews with scoring, and security vulnerability detection that finds a forgotten API key in code. Kredo concludes with a personal note about the Hamas attack on Israel that occurred while the Israel-based company's team was traveling to the summit, sharing that his co-founder and CEO left his pregnant wife to serve in military reserve duty.
whyItMatters: The talk connects its engineering abstractions, implementation choices, and AI/product implications into one practical system view.

sections.title: GAN-like Architecture for Code Generation
sections.summary: Kredo introduces the concept that GANs represented a compelling two-component architecture (generator and critic), but Transformers dropped the adversarial approach. He argues code is nuanced and needs a GAN-like system architecture with a code generation component and a code integrity critic component.

sections.title: CodiumAI Product Overview
sections.summary: CodiumAI focuses on the critic piece, helping developers understand code behaviors. They believe behavior coverage is more useful than code coverage. Tools are available via JetBrains and VS Code extensions, a Git plugin, and upcoming APIs for embedding in agents.

sections.title: Demo: Behavior Mapping and Test Generation
sections.summary: Live demo on Autoscraper, a 600-line open-source scraping class with 5000+ GitHub stars but no tests. CodiumAI maps behaviors at class and method level, generates detailed code explanations, and produces tests for happy paths, edge cases, and sub-behaviors, resulting in nine tests.

sections.title: Demo: Test Running, Auto-Fix, and Code Enhancement
sections.summary: Tests are run with an auto-fix mechanism that analyzes failures through chain-of-thought reflection and generates fixes. Code enhancement suggestions are shown, going beyond linting to address performance, security, best practices, and readability. A performance suggestion to replace hash lib with Blake3 is applied.

sections.title: Demo: PR Preparation and Review
sections.summary: Commit messages are generated via slash commands. PR review provides a summary, score, and detects issues including a potential security vulnerability from a forgotten API key. Slash improve suggests and applies a fix, demonstrating the code integrity component catching real issues.

sections.title: Conclusion and Personal Note
sections.summary: Kredo concludes by summarizing how CodiumAI supports the entire developer lifecycle. He shares a personal note about the Hamas attack on Israel that occurred while the Israel-based team was traveling, noting his co-founder and CEO is now in military reserve duty.
